name: Tabilo – Table Builder Block
author: Binsaifullah

sections.description:
Tabilo is a flexible, native table builder block for the WordPress block editor (Gutenberg). Create beautiful pricing tables, comparison tables, data tables, booking tables and more — right inside the editor, with a live preview and zero shortcodes.

Unlike traditional WordPress table plugins that lock you into plain text cells, Tabilo lets you insert any Gutenberg block inside a table cell — headings, paragraphs, images, buttons, lists, icons, star ratings, and even other blocks. If you can build it with blocks, you can put it in a Tabilo table.

Start fast with 40+ pre-designed table patterns, then customize colors, borders, spacing, and typography visually — no code required.

Why choose Tabilo?

  • Any content, any cell – insert any block into table cells for unlimited layouts.
  • Made for the block editor – a true native block, not an iframe or shortcode.
  • Beginner friendly – build a table visually with columns, rows, header and footer toggles.
  • Designer ready – fine-grained control over colors, borders, radius, padding and spacing.
  • Lightweight & fast – no jQuery, no bloat, clean semantic HTML output.
  • Translation ready – fully internationalized and RTL friendly.

Key Features

  • Flexible content – add any Gutenberg block (text, images, buttons, icons, ratings…) inside cells.
  • Visual table builder – set columns and rows, then edit directly in the editor.
  • Header & footer sections – optional table header and footer with independent styling.
  • Sticky header – keep column names visible while visitors scroll long tables, with a top offset control.
  • Fixed or auto layout – switch between fixed-width and content-based column sizing.
  • Responsive tables – horizontal-scroll mode with an optional scroll hint, or Stacked Card mode that turns each row into a labelled card on small screens.
  • Per-column colors – give any header or footer column its own text and background color.
  • Block styles – Default, Striped, and Separated styles out of the box.
  • Full styling controls – table, row, cell, header and footer colors, backgrounds, per-side borders, border radius, padding, border spacing and font sizes.
  • 40+ ready-made patterns – pricing, comparison, data and booking table designs to start in one click.
  • Bonus native blocks – a Star Rating block and an SVG Icon block (icon library + custom SVG) to enrich your tables.
  • Own block category – all Tabilo blocks are grouped under a dedicated “Tabilo” category in the inserter.

Included Blocks

  • Table Builder – the core flexible table block.
  • Table Row & Table Cell – structural blocks with their own color and border controls.
  • Star Rating – display ratings with an optional numeric value.
  • Icon – insert SVGs from the built-in library or paste your own custom SVG.

Ready-Made Table Patterns

Kickstart your layout with professionally designed patterns:

  • Pricing tables – 19 designs for plans, subscriptions and hosting.
  • Comparison tables – 14 designs for products, phones, laptops and features.
  • Data tables – 7 designs for sports standings, food menus, listings and more.
  • Booking tables – 3 designs for schedules and reservations.

Perfect For

  • Pricing and subscription tables
  • Product and feature comparison tables
  • Specification and data tables
  • Pros and cons tables
  • Booking, schedule and menu tables
  • Any content that needs a clean, structured, tabular layout
sections.installation:
From your WordPress Dashboard:

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “Tabilo”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual installation:

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Upload it via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Activate the plugin.

How to use:

  1. Create or edit a post or page.
  2. Click the “+” inserter and search for “Table Builder” (or open the Tabilo category).
  3. Choose a pre-designed pattern or select Start blank to build your own.
  4. Add columns, rows, a header/footer, then style it from the block sidebar.
sections.faq:
What is Tabilo?

Tabilo is a native table builder block for the WordPress block editor (Gutenberg) that lets you create responsive pricing, comparison and data tables without shortcodes or a page builder.

Can I add any type of content to table cells?

Yes. Tabilo lets you insert any Gutenberg block inside a cell — text, images, buttons, lists, icons, star ratings and even other blocks.

Do I need to know how to code?

No. Everything is built and styled visually from the block editor. No HTML, CSS or shortcodes are required.

Are the tables responsive?

Yes. Choose Horizontal Scroll to keep the table intact with an optional on-screen scroll hint, or Stacked Card to turn each row into a card below 768px — every cell is labelled with its column header, and you control how the cells and their labels are arranged. More responsive modes are on the roadmap.

Can I customize the table design?

Absolutely. You get comprehensive controls for colors, backgrounds, per-side borders, border radius, padding, border spacing and font sizes, plus Default, Striped and Separated block styles. Header and footer columns can also be colored one by one — handy for highlighting a recommended pricing plan.

Does Tabilo include ready-made templates?

Yes. It ships with 40+ pre-designed patterns for pricing, comparison, data and booking tables that you can insert and edit in one click.

Will it work with my theme?

Tabilo follows WordPress block standards and works with any properly coded block or classic theme that supports the block editor.

Does it slow down my site?

No. Tabilo is lightweight, loads no jQuery, and outputs clean semantic HTML, so your tables stay fast.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • New: Stacked Card responsive mode – below 768px each row becomes a card, with the header text repeated as a label on every cell. Choose a Row Direction (cells stacked vertically or side by side) and a Cell Direction (label beside the value or above it).
  • New: Sticky header – keep the header row in view while visitors scroll a long table, with an optional top offset for themes with a fixed admin or site header.
  • New: Per-column header and footer colors – the Table Head and Table Footer panels now list one collapsible group per column, each with its own text and background color.
  • New: Settings → Tabilo admin page – plugin info, a quick-start guide, recommendations and links to demos, tutorials and support.
  • Improvement: clearer labelling in the block sidebar for the responsive and color controls.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
